purpose: Repeatability of available workflows and observed failures; not a new held-out test or a claim that every goal is attainable.
reset: same frozen SQLite baseline and fresh browser context per case
change_policy: Do not edit the chosen rules, scripts, adapter or Harness during these replays. If new contradictions appear, preserve them and classify separately.
activation: All goals and prediction checks must pass; known website failures do not receive a waiver.
